test_struct_accessor_dtypes: test the struct accessor dtypes property returns field types as a Series with field names as index
test_struct_accessor_field: test the struct accessor field method extracts a named or indexed field from a struct Series
test_struct_accessor_field_with_invalid_: test the struct accessor field raises ValueError when given an invalid float argument
test_struct_accessor_explode: test the struct accessor explode method converts a struct Series into a DataFrame with one column per field
test_struct_accessor_api_for_invalid: test the struct accessor raises AttributeError when used on a non-struct dtype Series
